EX-99.1 2 ntla-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Intellia Therapeutics Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Business Updates - On track to complete lonvo-z commercial readiness efforts in advance of March 10, 2027 PDUFA date - New lonvo-z patient perspectives and Phase 1/2 durability data to be included in investor webcast and multiple presentations next week at ACAAI 2026 - Completed enrollment in MAGNITUDE-2 Phase 3 clinical trial in ATTRv-PN; advanced enrollment in MAGNITUDE in ATTR-CM - Existing cash resources expected to fund operations at least into 2028 and well beyond lonvo-z’s anticipated commercial launch, with recent term loan facility providing additional financial flexibility CAMBRIDGE, Mass., November 5, 2026 – Intellia Therapeutics, Inc.

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) accepted the Biologics License Application (BLA) for lonvo-z and granted the BLA Priority Review with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of March 10, 2027.
